qa_pair.question: Using only read-only ArangoDB MCP tools, list collections whose names start with mcp_eval_, then query the evaluation orders and customers. Which customer name has the highest total value across non-cancelled orders?
Using read-only tools, inspect mcp_eval_products and mcp_eval_orders. Which product SKU has the largest total shipped quantity?
Using read-only tools, join mcp_eval_orders with mcp_eval_customers. What tier is associated with the customer who placed order_1002?
Using read-only tools, query mcp_eval_shipments and mcp_eval_orders. Which order key is shipped but not yet delivered?

Using read-only tools, compare mcp_eval_products stock with ordered quantities across all non-cancelled orders. Which product has the least remaining stock after subtracting non-cancelled ordered quantity?
Using read-only tools, query mcp_eval_orders and mcp_eval_customers. How many non-cancelled orders were placed by customers in the NA region?
Using read-only tools, inspect mcp_eval_products and find the category of the highest priced product. What is that category?
Using read-only tools, query mcp_eval_orders with a low limit first and continue reasoning from the returned rows. What is the total value of shipped orders?
Using read-only tools, join mcp_eval_shipments with mcp_eval_orders and mcp_eval_products. Which carrier is handling the shipment for the Edge Driver order?
Using read-only tools, list the mcp_eval_ collections and query their document counts. How many seeded evaluation collections are present?
